rules.title: Give the mark room.
rules.text: Leave at least one symbol-height of clear space around the logo.

rules.title: Choose the right contrast.
rules.text: Use ink on light backgrounds, and the white mark on dark ones.

rules.title: Use the colour values.
rules.text: Copy the exact codes below. Keep accents purposeful and restrained.

rules.title: Keep type simple.
rules.text: Use Inter for headlines and body copy. Let size create the hierarchy.

rules.title: Make it human.
rules.text: Be clear, useful, and warm. Say what matters, then stop.
